# pcd_keymanager_container (Resource)

Manages a container in PCD's Barbican key manager — a named grouping of secrets (generic, RSA, or certificate). Containers are immutable; any change forces a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_keymanager_secret" "example" {
  name                 = "tf-example-tls-key"
  payload              = "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\n...\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"
  payload_content_type = "text/plain"
}

resource "pcd_keymanager_container" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-container"
  type = "generic"

  secret_refs = [{
    name       = "private_key"
    secret_ref = pcd_keymanager_secret.example.secret_ref
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) The container type: generic, rsa, or certificate. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the container. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `secret_refs` (Attributes Set) The secrets in the container. Changing these forces a new resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secret_refs))

### Read-Only

- `consumers` (Attributes List) Services consuming this container. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consumers))
- `container_ref` (String) The full Barbican container reference URL.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) The container UUID.
- `status` (String) The container status (e.g. ACTIVE).

<a id="nestedatt--secret_refs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secret_refs`

Required:

- `secret_ref` (String) The full secret reference URL.

Optional:

- `name` (String) A label for the secret within the container (e.g. private_key).


<a id="nestedatt--consumers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consumers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The consumer name.
- `url` (String) The consumer URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_keymanager_container.example <id>
```
